scope.title: Portable and governed recording interactions
scope.boundary: Executable checks inspect selection and reference structure; Workflow/CLI own operational transitions and writes.

initial_state: Use the independent ten-profile table in recording_profile: route, verify, pr, design-review, delivery-review, plan, implement, code-review, proposal and proposal-review.

Each temporary body contains Recording boundary, Invocation classification with its profile trigger and the exact READ map. The selected reference contains the complete synthetic primary-contract block.
Call validate_targeted_recording_profile and require no errors before each one-field mutation.

Use the Review fixture basis in the strategy plus this case’s concrete facts and counterexample. Resolve every actual instruction and authority claim to the exact current owner/body/triggered resources.
Materialize a fresh private review packet for each variant. F0/F1/F2, G0/G1/G2 and S0/S1 are synthetic byte-identity labels; an actual assessment records inspected identities.
Inspect proposed decisions, outputs and prohibited side effects without running an agent or writing production, workflow records, hosted CI or publication state.

cases.title: Removing the body boundary does not bypass recording validation
cases.risk: Moving recording details allows an early-return validator to skip the selected profile.

conditions: Rename only Recording boundary to Unknown boundary.

then: The sole diagnostic is missing body recording boundary for the actual skill path.

cases.title: Classification and load triggers are both required
cases.risk: A reference exists but the selected invocation never reaches it.

conditions: Replace the exact trigger with unknown_value in either Invocation classification or the map entry, preserving the other.

when: Validate both mutations for every listed profile.
then: Each mutation reports the missing selected-reference body classification/load trigger and names the required trigger.

cases.title: An unrelated reference cannot satisfy the selected profile
cases.risk: A search finds required words somewhere in the package and accepts a broken load path.

conditions: Compare a map selecting unknown_value.md and a missing selected file with a complete unrelated file plus inline profile.

when: Validate the selected profile after each independent mutation.
then: Reject the wrong mapping by its expected resource path; reject the missing selected file even though the required text exists elsewhere.

cases.title: Selected references are contained and decodable
cases.risk: A selected procedure escapes through a symlink or unreadable bytes.

conditions: Replace the selected reference by a symlink to outside.md outside the skill, or by invalid UTF-8 bytes ff.

when: Validate on fresh baselines for every profile.
then: The symlink reports selected recording reference escapes skill root; invalid bytes report selected recording reference unreadable with UnicodeDecodeError.

cases.title: Selected recording procedure retains required structure
cases.risk: A loadable file is assumed to contain the current recording contract.

conditions: Remove expected_revision from the selected block or rename its Explicit recording heading.

when: Validate every current profile from its passing baseline.
then: Reject the missing primary contract token or missing Explicit recording profile with exactly the intended diagnostic. Token presence establishes structure only; actual supported-command semantics are assessed in SKL-RX-008.

cases.title: Portable absence and malformed governed intent differ
cases.risk: A malformed governed request silently becomes portable and bypasses required authority.

conditions: Compare a valid portable proposal in a customer project without the RigorLoop checkout, a valid explicitly governed request, and a governed signal with conflicting or missing authority.

when: Walk the classification before reference loading and any proposed record mutation.
then: Portable output uses supplied/project-local authority and requires no recording CLI; governed work loads the complete supported procedure; malformed governed intent stops dependent work without portable fallback or completion claims.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.

cases.title: Late recording triggers do not arm downstream automation
cases.risk: A manual review becomes automated delivery merely because its finding must be recorded.

conditions: Start with an isolated manual Code Review with no planned/armed execution. Introduce a material durable finding midway, with valid current recording authority.

when: Trace resource selection and the proposed handoff before a record write and after saving it.
then: Load current recording procedure before the write; preserve isolation and independent review duties. A saved finding grants no milestone closure, implementation continuation or automation. Workflow owns any subsequent routing decision.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.

cases.title: Recording results remain distinct from approval
cases.risk: A rejected, conflicting or interrupted CLI write is reported as completed or approved.

conditions: Supply supported current CLI context/result examples for saved, conflict and recovery-required, with exact reviewed subject identities.

when: Inspect the proposed skill response, reread requirements and recovery handoff against CLI/Records and Workflow owners.
then: Only saved reports persistence; none of the three establishes approval. Conflict requires fresh basis and reassessment; recovery-required routes to authorized store recovery without a success claim. Detailed atomicity and neighbor-preservation cases stay with CLI/Records.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.
